summary: feat: cost tracking + dual-axis (queries + USD) budget enforcement
description:
Forward-compatible cost tracking spec, additive-only — no renames or aliases.

## Schema additions (additive only)

ALTER TABLE queries ADD:
  - cost_usd            NUMERIC(10, 6)    NULL    -- NULL on historical rows pre-tracking; backfilled in child 6
  - cached_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL  DEFAULT 0  -- DeepSeek doesn't cache; default covers absence

NOT adding 'max_tokens' as a column — keep the cap in code (src/lib/model.ts MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS) so tweaking doesn't need a migration.

NOT renaming 'model_used' to 'model_id' — keep additive.

## New tables

CREATE TABLE model_pricing (
    model_id                    TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_price_per_mtok        NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL,
    output_price_per_mtok       NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL,
    cached_input_price_per_mtok NUMERIC(10, 4),       -- null when model doesn't cache
    effective_from              TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    effective_to                TIMESTAMPTZ,           -- null = currently active
    PRIMARY KEY (model_id, effective_from)
);

CREATE TABLE user_budgets (
    user_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    period       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('daily', 'monthly')),
    query_limit  INTEGER,                              -- nullable: unenforced on this axis
    usd_limit    NUMERIC(10, 4),
    queries_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    usd_used     NUMERIC(10, 6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reset_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, period)
);

quota_usage stays for now (will be deprecated once user_budgets is the source of truth in code; drop in a separate cleanup PR).

## Pricing source

OpenRouter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models — public, no auth. Per-model pricing:
  pricing.prompt              = per input token (USD)
  pricing.completion          = per output token
  pricing.input_cache_read    = per cached input token (when supported)
A small sync script populates model_pricing on demand; manual operator run on price changes (cron later if it matters).

## Enforcement: pre-flight reserve, post-flight finalize

Picked 'reservation' over 'check-only' to close the multi-tab race window:
  reserveBudget(userId, tier, estimatedCostUsd) → atomically increments both axes; rejects on overrun
  finalizeBudget(userId, estimatedCostUsd, actualCostUsd) → adjusts usd_used by (actual - estimated)

estimated_cost = (input_tokens) * input_price + MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS * output_price (worst case).

Either limit nullable means unenforced on that axis. Free tier today: query_limit=10, usd_limit=null. Pro today: query_limit=30, usd_limit=null. Future: pro could move to query_limit=null, usd_limit=$0.50/day.

## Backfill

Live OpenRouter usage so far: 9 requests, ~$0.167 total (Sonnet 2 / DeepSeek 7).  Backfill script computes cost_usd for existing rows from current pricing.

## Children (in implementation order)

  1. schema migration (006_cost_and_budgets.sql)
  2. scripts/sync-pricing.ts + initial seed of model_pricing
  3. src/lib/cost.ts — pricing lookup + cost computation
  4. src/lib/budget.ts — reserve/finalize (replaces checkAndIncrement semantics)
  5. wire into /api/query (persist cost) + /api/quota (return both axes)
  6. scripts/backfill-cost.ts — fill cost_usd on the existing 9 rows

## Forward-compat (when model selection ships)

  - Expose model choice in /api/query payload — model_used already per-row
  - UI swaps queries display → dollar burn — /api/quota already returns both
  - Add per-tier budget configs — user_budgets already supports nullable axes
  - No schema, enforcement, or logging change required

resolution.note: Schema (006), pricing sync (sync-pricing.ts), cost compute (lib/cost.ts), spend tracking (lib/spend.ts), API wire-in (/api/query, /api/quota), backfill (backfill-cost.ts). Forward-compat for model selection lands without further schema changes.
